comment: Packaged default calibration. Deterministic and memory backends are intentionally absent (identity mapping) so calibration never changes a default install's decisions. Embedding curves are conservative: reference_value (allowed-values evidence) can clear the 0.95 auto threshold only for near-exact matches; category_synonym (pure clustering, no allowed-values evidence) is capped below 0.95 so it stays suggest-only at default thresholds.
